map.为什么除以年金因子？: Why divide by the annuity factor?
map.趸缴是现值，年缴是年金流；现值/年金因子把现值均摊到每年，保证精算等价。: A single premium is a present value and annual premiums an annuity stream; present value divided by the annuity factor spreads it evenly across years, keeping actuarial equivalence.
map.均衡保费早期为什么亏？: Why is level premium loss-making early on?
map.均衡保费把趸缴现值均摊到每年，早期收取的保费高于当年风险成本，差额形成准备金（前: Level premium spreads the present value of a single premium evenly across years; premiums collected early exceed that year's risk cost, and the difference forms reserves (early surplus) used to cover later premium shortfalls - the essence of life insurance cash flow design.
